rule: variant-by-variant; bounds re-derived from sources; bound types never merged; selector question only after parameter-space reconstruction

model_variants.description: original DP: unregularized point-particle mass density
model_variants.fate: ENERGY_NON_CONSERVATION_KNOWN_DEFECT + effectively excluded by any finite lower bound (collapse rate diverges)

model_variants.description: Markovian white-noise DP; R0 enters as Gaussian smearing of mass density
model_variants.R0_definition: mass density smeared over Gaussian of width R0; units length
bounds: Ghirardi et al 1990 (heating): weak lower bound, supreseded
Donadi et al 2021 Gran Sasso radiation: HARD_EMPIRICAL_BOUND R0 >~ 4e-10 m (4 A), ~3 orders above previous bounds

model_variants.description: mass-density resolution form (Diosi 2013): finite R0 conjectured to cure residual energy non-conservation
model_variants.R0_definition: same Gaussian smearing; R0 = resolution of mass density operator
model_variants.R0_status: CONJECTURAL_PHYSICAL_SCALE + PHENOMENOLOGICAL_PARAMETER; finite-R0 construction itself CONJECTURE

model_variants.description: parameter-free version: R0 fixed at nuclear size (~1e-15 m)
model_variants.R0_definition: R0 = nucleon radius, chosen by naturalness
model_variants.fate: EXCLUDED by Donadi 2021 (confirms bound applies at R0 ~ nuclear size)

bound_registry.observable: collapse-induced diffusion noise in GW detector test masses
radiation emission (Lamb shift-like) from charged-particle diffusion
bound_registry.source: Donadi et al, Nat Phys 17, 74-78 (2021), arXiv:2111.13490
bound_registry.value: R0 >~ 4e-10 m (4 Angstrom), ~3 orders above previous bounds
bound_registry.variant_applicability: all finite-R0 Markovian DP variants; assumptions: nucleon mass density, standard nuclear composition
bound_registry.environmental_confound_handling: deep underground location suppresses cosmic/environmental radiation; dedicated background characterization

bound_registry.observable: collapse of smallest visible object (graphene plate L~25um, d=4L) within eye resolution time tau_obs ~ 0.01 s
bound_registry.value: R0 <~ 1e-4 m (1e6 Angstrom) for L=246um plate variant
bound_registry.scope_warning: source itself states: 'Clearly there is a lot of ambiguity in this request, given that the macroscopic domain cannot be defined precisely'; bound depends on chosen object (graphene plate), definition of 'smallest visible object', tau_obs, and superposition distance; also finds DP 'strictly speaking does not satisfy this requirement' at face value

bound_registry.observable: various (spontaneous radiation, X-ray emission, optomechanical noise)
bound_registry.status: weaker than B4 for R0 lower bound on this variant

surviving_parameter_space.upper_boundary_status: EFFECTIVENESS_CRITERION (model-purpose requirement, explicitly ambiguous per its own source; to some degree arbitrary)
conditional_on: Markovian form (2007) rather than original 1989 dynamics
surviving_parameter_space.emphatic: surviving window != successful theory; falsifiable != derived

distinguishing_observables_in_window.status: used by B4; stronger versions probe upper window

distinguishing_observables_in_window.channel: spontaneous heating of mechanical oscillators / optomechanics
loss of interferometric visibility for mesoscopic superpositions
distinguishing_observables_in_window.distinctive: CONDITIONAL: must beat environmental decoherence by design (d dependence differs from thermal/gas decoherence)

environmental_confound_firewall.required_comparison: DP collapse rate Gamma_DP(d, R0) vs Gamma_env(thermal, gas, blackbody, EM, technical)
environmental_confound_firewall.key_discriminator: different dependence on superposition distance d and mass: DP ~ E_G(d)/hbar scaling vs linear-in-d environmental decoherence
environmental_confound_firewall.status: unresolved for much of the surviving window at current experimental sensitivity

R0_selector_investigation.question: Is R0 independently selected, constrained, or merely fitted?

routes_tested.result: ABSENT - tau ~ hbar/E_G heuristic never derived
ABSENT - finite R0 IS the conjectural 2013 repair; R0 is the free ingredient of the repair
ABSENT - dimensional analysis gives ranges not values
PARTIAL - hard lower bound 4 A (Gran Sasso); upper bound only via effectiveness criterion

R0_selector_investigation.verdict: FREE_PHENOMENOLOGICAL_PARAMETER (with CONDITIONALLY_CONSTRAINED status: lower bound empirical, upper bound criterion-dependent)
R0_selector_investigation.post_hoc_fit_check: natural parameter-free choice R0 ~ nuclear size was made BEFORE Donadi 2021 (good faith), and was EXCLUDED - the surviving region is defined by experiment, not by an independent principle

compression_score_impact: NOT RESCORED per protocol (rescoring is a separate authorized phase). But note: parameter-free DP was the source of DP's compression advantage; that version is excluded, so DP's effective compression has degraded to a 6-order phenomenological window.
limitations: bound values quoted from source abstracts/figures; exact confidence intervals not re-derived from raw data
upper bound R0 < 1e-4 m is criterion-dependent and was flagged as ambiguous by its own source
non-Markovian DP variants not fully bounded here
relativistic DP: open for all variants
